resources.string: Enter the OpenSubsonic address and the account you use with that server.
Allow HTTP on this local network
Use only for a server you control on a private local network.
Dulcet is checking the server, signing in, and reading account capabilities.
This account is saved. Dulcet remains disconnected until you choose Connect.
After a successful connection, Dulcet encrypts these credentials with the Android Keystore.
The server address is incomplete or unsupported.
Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS OpenSubsonic server address, then try again.
Internationalized host names must use their ASCII spelling.
Convert the host to punycode, such as xn--msik-0ra.example.invalid for müsik.example.invalid, then try again.
The server could not be reached
Dulcet could not establish a network connection to the server.
Check that the server is running and reachable from this device, then try again.
The server took too long to respond
Account setup exceeded its response deadline.
Check the server and network, then try again.
Dulcet stopped the active account connection.
Choose Connect whenever you are ready to try again.
The server certificate is not trusted
Android could not establish a trusted HTTPS connection to this server.
Install the issuing CA certificate in the operating-system trust store, correct the certificate, or use another trusted HTTPS endpoint.
The connection was refused for security
The requested address or redirect violated the account-connection security policy.
Use a trusted HTTPS endpoint, or explicitly allow HTTP only for a server on this local network.
This is not a compatible OpenSubsonic endpoint
The server response did not match the supported OpenSubsonic protocol.
Check the server address and version, then try again.
The server could not complete account setup
The server reported an error while Dulcet was establishing the account.
Review the account and server settings, then try again.
The server or an intermediary rejected the authentication method or credentials.
Check the credentials and any reverse-proxy authentication, then try again.
Account setup was redirected to another host
The server redirected account setup to %1$s.
Use an OpenSubsonic /rest/ endpoint that does not require an SSO or identity-provider redirect.
A required server capability is unavailable
This server does not provide a capability required for account setup.
Update the server or use a compatible OpenSubsonic endpoint.
The account could not be saved
Dulcet left the account disconnected because Android Keystore persistence failed.
Unable to sync. Saved music remains available.
No saved music yet. Sync your library to browse offline.
This album is no longer in the saved library.
This artist is no longer in the saved library.
Playback failed. Check your connection, then press Play to try again.
